rules: Use Inter or system-ui sans-serif across all headings and body text.
Headings > 32px must always use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for Apple-level typographic tension.
Never exceed text-7xl for H1 to maintain fluid responsiveness.
Maintain clear contrast ratio (WCAG AA / APCA compliant) in both light and dark themes.

structure.description: Sticky top bar with warranty, open-box savings, and trade-in promotion marquee ticker

Glassmorphic header with AppleBase brand logo, navigation links (Mac, iPad, iPhone, Watch, Audio, Certified Refurbished), search bar input modal trigger, theme toggle (Light/Dark), and cart drawer trigger with dynamic badge count
Fixed full-screen 3D WebGL background (<canvas>) pinned with GSAP ScrollTrigger
Hero section: 'Innovation Reimagined'. Kinetic masked headline reveal, subheader, key metrics, scroll indicator, quick CTA buttons
Feature callout: 'Precision Engineered'. Apple-style multi-column bento grid detailing aerospace titanium frame, M-series architecture, micro-LED retina panel, and 30-day trial guarantee

Interactive E-Commerce Storefront Showcase: Categorized into 'Hot Deals', 'Available Now', and 'Recommended'. Filterable product cards with condition chips (New / Open-Box / Used—Excellent), price tags, savings callouts, stock counters, and Add-to-Cart controls
Final CTA & Tech Specs: 'Available Now'. Detailed specification row (Processor, Display, Battery, Connectivity), trade-in estimation tool trigger, 1-click Express Checkout CTA, and storefront footer

three_js_specifications.responsive: Dynamic window resize listener updating camera aspect ratio and renderer size

phases.mesh_transform: Rotates 180 degrees smoothly on Y/X axes and scales up by 1.25x
phases.visual_effect: Cinematic heavy spin with subtle lighting transition

phases.mesh_transform: Translates horizontally to the right/left while section text shifts opposite, followed by a tight macro zoom (scale 2.2x)
phases.visual_effect: Focus spotlight on metallic surface details

phases.mesh_transform: Returns to floating center position with continuous gentle orbit rotation
phases.visual_effect: Ambient floating breathing effect behind checkout card

fallbacks_and_accessibility.webgl_fallback: If WebGL fails or context is lost, display a CSS animated gradient metallic ring with subtle blur and glass backdrop
fallbacks_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Detect prefers-reduced-motion media query and disable camera/mesh scroll animations, maintaining stationary elegant backdrop
fallbacks_and_accessibility.dom_first_principle: All product details, pricing, filter inputs, cart actions, and checkout forms are rendered in accessible DOM elements with proper semantic tags and ARIA attributes.

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, badges, condition tags, theme toggles, cart triggers, and product items MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_for_main_agent: Work directly in /app/frontend/src utilizing JavaScript (.js) files.
Integrate Three.js, GSAP with ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion, and Lenis smooth scrolling.
Implement full Dark/Light theme switching with 'light' as default, storing setting in localStorage and applying dark class to documentElement.
Ensure all storefront commerce capabilities are fully functional (Cart drawer, item counter, condition filtering, search filter, toast notifications via Sonner).
Keep 3D canvas fixed in background with pin: true, scrub: 1.2 for Apple-like momentum felt scroll animation.
